question: The 7th ICC T20 World Cup Cricket was jointly organised by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **UAE and Oman.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 2021 ICC Men's T20 World Cup **was the 7th ICC Men's T20 World Cup tournament. 
 
• The matches played in the United Arab Emirates and Oman from **17 October to 14 November 2021.**
 
• The United Arab Emirates are the relations between the **United Arab Emirates and Oman.**
 
• With a total of 45 matches, the T20 World Cup was composed of two rounds. 
 
• ICC T20 World Cup 2021 Most Runs was** Babar Azam with 303 Runs Tops The List.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The U.A.E**. has an embassy in Muscat while Oman maintains an embassy in Abu Dhabi and a consulate-general in Dubai.
 
• U.A.E. and Oman, both countries are part of the **Middle East region **and share close cultural ties.
 
• The United Arab Emirates is one of the** Persian Gulf States.**
